design_issues.screen: RoofSketchEditor Proposals panel (L-Roof, high-confidence solver output)
issues: Even though readiness = 'High confidence' and Validation = 'No issues', per-facet SF proposals show non-trivial deltas from measured (F1 300->391 +91, F2 200->279 +79, F3 250->280 +30, F4 150->168 +18). These are 30%+ overstatements on F1/F2 driven by the solver's chosen plate depth (10 ft) vs. the measured width (11.18 ft from 6/12 pitch on the depth-of-40 ridge). This is a solver approximation ambiguity, not a runtime error, but users may find it confusing that a 'High confidence' proposal still needs 'Accept Proposed / Keep Current' on every facet. Consider auto-scaling depth from measured width or surfacing a subtle 'Approximated plate depth' note when SF diff > 20%.

critical_code_review_comments: frameRoof solver appears to output geometry in unit-square coordinates (widths of 10 or 30 ft) rather than scaling to measured facet widths. The proposal panel already flags the per-facet SF diff, but the discrepancy vs. measured (11.18 ft width for a 40-ft-ridge / 300 SF plane) suggests the solver should scale by measured area or width. Since test passes for readiness/geometry structure, this is a follow-up refinement, not a blocker.

The empty-sketch backend call GET /api/measurements/{revId}/sketches/{sid} returns 404 and logs a console error; consider swallowing this expected 404 or returning an empty 200 body to avoid noisy console errors on every fresh sketch open.
